Are you passionate about transport and logistics? Bleckmann is looking for you!

This is a temporary assignment during a busy and dynamic peak period. It's a great opportunity to gain experience in logistics. As Bleckmann operates multiple peak periods throughout the year, you will have the opportunity to return for future assignments.

Are you interested in this opportunity? Be sure to read this vacancy!

Tasks: 

• Preparing incoming orders

• You prepare the orders in order of arrival using a scanning system

• You prepare the correct documents when packing orders

We organize bus transport from Antwerp to ensure easy access to Bleckmann:  

• Pick up at Sint-Jansplein 

• Departure at 4u30

 

• Positive attitude

• Good numerical skills

• Flexibility

• Punctuality

• Fluent in either Dutch, English or French

What do you have to do?
 

 
• As a production line operator, you set up the machine according to the correct parameters and make adjustments as needed.
 
• You inspect the quality of the finished products.
 
• You supply raw materials and packaging materials to the production line.
 
• Your responsibilities will also include changing machine setups, as well as cleaning and maintaining the production line. 

Who are you?
 

 
• You are willing to work in the food industry
 
• You adhere to hygiene and safety standards
 
• You have your own transportation
 
• You have a good to very good knowledge of Dutch or English

• You are willing to complete in-house training
 
• You have a truly hands-on attitude

Do you also love the idea of working in chocolate? Then this opportunity is definitely for you! We are looking for production workers who can help out during the upcoming chocolate season. What will you be doing?
 

 
• Packing pralines, seashell chocolates, chocolate bars, etc. into boxes

• Carrying out quality control checks 

Who are you?
 

 
• You are able to work in a two-shift system (5 a.m.–1 p.m. / 1 p.m.–9 p.m.) or possibly a fixed night shift (9 p.m.–5 a.m.)

jobs.occupation: Product Specialist Fiber Lasers & Press Brakes - Europe
jobs.description:
European HQ Brussels | Fiber Laser & Press Brake Expertise | Technical & Commercial Support | International En
Join the European headquarters of an international CNC machine tool manufacturer as a Product Specialist Fiber Laser & Press Brake in Brussels. In this permanent role, you will combine technical product expertise with commercial support, helping dealers, sales teams and customers across Europe find the right fiber laser and press brake solutions.
 You will work in an international environment and travel approximately one week per month across Europe for customer and dealer visits, machine demonstrations and trade fairs.

 Job at a glance

• Location: Brussels, Belgium
• Contract: Permanent
• Working hours: Full-time, 38 or 40 hours per week
• Salary: Up to approximately €5,500 gross per month, depending on experience
• Travel: Approximately one week per month within Europe
• Languages: Fluent Dutch and English
• Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical field
• Benefits: Electric company car, charging or fuel card, insurance, pension plan and €10 meal vouchers
• Working hours: Flexible
About the organisation

This international machine tool manufacturer is a market leader in CNC machine tools across the Western world. Its product portfolio includes CNC machining centers, lathes, fiber lasers and press brakes.
To further strengthen its fiber laser and press brake activities in Europe, the company is looking for a Product Specialist who combines technical expertise with strong commercial awareness.
 You will join a small, approachable and international team at the European headquarters in Brussels. The working environment offers considerable autonomy and short communication lines.

 

 
Your new role
As Product Specialist Fiber Laser & Press Brake, you will be the European point of reference for fiber laser and press brake solutions.

You will support dealers, sales teams and end customers throughout the commercial and technical process, from pre-sales and machine configuration to demonstrations, training, product launches and technical support.

What will you do?

• Provide technical support for product- and application-related questions.
• Advise customers, dealers and sales teams on applications and suitable machine configurations.
• Analyse and resolve product-related technical challenges.
• Support dealers and sales teams throughout commercial sales processes.
• Develop clear product positioning and technical sales arguments.
• Deliver product and application training to dealers and sales teams.
• Demonstrate fiber laser and press brake machines at customer sites, events and trade fairs.
• Support new product launches across the European market.
• Gather customer, dealer and market feedback and identify potential business opportunities.
• Collaborate with Sales, Service, Marketing and Product Management.
• Maintain regular contact with international colleagues and stakeholders.The position covers the European market, with approximately one week of international travel per month.
 
 
What do you need? Essential
• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical field.
• Experience in a technical, engineering, product management or technical-commercial environment.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• The ability to translate technical challenges into practical solutions.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical information clearly to different audiences.
• A customer-focused and commercially minded approach.
• Experience coordinating projects and working with internal and external stakeholders.
• A structured way of working with attention to quality and detail.
• A proactive and results-oriented mindset.
• Fluent Dutch and English.
• Willingness to travel approximately one week per month within Europe.Your strengths
 You are eager to learn and motivated to develop in-depth knowledge of fiber laser, press brake and CNC machine technologies. You enjoy combining technical problem-solving with customer contact and commercial thinking, and you are comfortable working with colleagues and stakeholders across different European markets.

European HQ Brussels | CNC Machine Expertise | Technical Sales Support | European Scope | International Environment | Permanent Contract

What do you need?
Essential

• Experience with machining centres, lathes, fiber lasers or press brakes is a strong advantage.
• The ability to understand technical challenges and translate them into practical solutions.

• A customer-focused and commercially minded approach.
• Experience coordinating projects or working with different internal and external stakeholders.
• A structured way of working with attention to quality and detail.

You enjoy solving technical problems, but you also understand the urgency and business impact behind a sales opportunity.You are comfortable taking ownership, coordinating different stakeholders and following issues through until they are resolved. As you will regularly work independently and travel throughout Europe, you can structure your own activities and make well-considered decisions.
 You are also:

• Hands-on and solution-oriented
• Proactive and responsive

jobs.occupation: Junior Business Assistant – Research & Development | P&G
jobs.description:
Contract Type: Temporary assignment 
Duration: 23 November 2026 – 22 November 2027

We are looking for a Junior Business Assistant to join the Research & Development (R&D) department of a leading multinational consumer goods company. In this entry-level role, you will provide essential administrative and operational support to R&D teams and managers, helping ensure smooth and efficient day-to-day business operations. You will work in a dynamic, international environment where you will collaborate with different teams, navigate multiple systems, and contribute to continuous process improvement. 

As a Junior Business Assistant, you will play an important role in supporting the daily operations of the R&D department. Your responsibilities will include: 

 
• Calendar & Meeting Management: Schedule appointments, coordinate meetings, book meeting rooms, prepare agendas, and organize business travel. 
 
•  
 Travel & Expense Management: Arrange business trips, process expense reports, and ensure that travel-related administration is handled accurately and efficiently. 

 
• Administrative & Operational Support: Maintain databases and documentation, track team members' absences, order office supplies, and place and manage purchase orders. 
 
•  
 Communication & Employee Support: Act as a point of contact for employees, respond to questions, and ensure information is communicated accurately and in a timely manner. 

 
• Project Assistance: Provide ad hoc administrative and operational support for ongoing projects, team activities, and events. 
 
• Process Improvement & Documentation: Proactively identify opportunities to simplify and improve existing processes, and contribute to documenting and optimizing work procedures. 
 
• Systems & Data Management: Work with multiple digital platforms and data sources, including SAP and internal and external data portals, ensuring that information remains accurate and up to date. 

We are looking for an enthusiastic, eager-to-learn individual who takes initiative, adapts quickly to changing priorities, and enjoys helping others. The ideal candidate will have: 

 
•  
 Education: A high school diploma or equivalent. A degree or qualification in Business Administration, Office Management, or a related field is an advantage. 

 
•  
Digital Skills: Excellent knowledge of MS Office, particularly Excel. Familiarity with SAP and other business applications is a plus. An interest in using AI tools to improve efficiency is also desirable. 

 
• Organizational Skills: The ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously, maintain an overview of ongoing activities, and meet deadlines. 
 

 
• Proactive Mindset: A hands-on approach, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to independently identify opportunities for improvement. 
 
• Agility & Flexibility: The ability to adapt to changing priorities and work confidently across multiple systems, processes, and information sources. 
 
• Attention to Detail & Discretion: A structured and accurate way of working, with the ability to handle confidential information responsibly. 
 
•  
 Communication & Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate clearly and work effectively with different stakeholders. 

 
• Process-Oriented Thinking: An interest in simplifying and improving workflows, with the ability to document processes clearly and accurately. 
 
•  
 Language Skills: Good written and spoken English.

• You monitor stock levels and report shortages in a timely manner.

• You work an early, day or late shift – working hours vary depending on the schedule and the day.

• You are comfortable working in a chilled environment of approximately 7°C.
